messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference “long‑weekend” calendar for **Canada in 2023**.  
It shows the *federal* statutory holidays that automatically turn a regular weekend into a multi‑day break, and it adds the most widely observed *provincial* holidays that do the same (e.g., Family Day, Civic Holiday, etc.).  

> ⚠️ **Tip:** Provincial rules differ—check your own province’s official holiday schedule before adding anything to your app.

---

### 1️⃣ Federal Statutory Holidays → National Long Weekends

| Date(s) | Holiday | How It Creates a Long Weekend |
|---------|--------|--------------------------------|
| **April 7–9** | Good Friday (Fri) | Friday + Sat/Sun = 3‑day weekend |
| **May 21–23** | Victoria Day (Mon) | Sat/Sun + Monday = 3‑day weekend |
| **September 2–4** | Labour Day (Mon) | Sat/Sun + Monday = 3‑day weekend |
| **December 23–26** | Christmas (Mon) + Boxing Day (Tue) | Sat/Sun + Mon/Tue = 4‑day stretch |

*(Note:* Canada Day (July 1) landed on a Saturday in 2023, so it didn’t add extra days beyond the usual weekend.)

---

### 2️⃣ Common Provincial / Territorial Variants

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Typical Date (2023) | Resulting Long Weekend |
|--------------------|----------|---------------------|-----------------------|
| British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Newfoundland & Labrador | **Family Day** | Second Monday of Feb (Feb 20) | Sat 18–Mon 20 |
| Ontario | **Family Day** | First Monday of Feb (Feb 13) | Sat 11–Mon 13 |
| Manitoba | **St. Patrick’s Day** | First Monday of Mar (Mar 6) | Sat 4–Mon 6 |
| Nova Scotia | **Civic Holiday** | First Monday of Aug (Aug 7) | Sat 5–Mon 7 |
| Prince Edward Island | **Civic Holiday** | First Monday of Aug (Aug 7) | Sat 5–Mon 7 |
| Yukon | **Yukon Day** | First Monday of Aug (Aug 7) | Sat 5–Mon 7 |
| Northwest Territories | **NWT Day** | First Monday of Aug (Aug 7) | Sat 5–Mon 7 |
| Nunavut | **Nunavut Day** | First Monday of Aug (Aug 7) | Sat 5–Mon 7 |
| Québec | **Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day** | June 24 (Friday) | Friday + Sat/Sun = 3‑day weekend |
| Atlantic Provinces | **Remembrance Day** | November 11 (Wednesday) | Only a single weekday holiday (no long weekend) |

> 👉 **Quick rule of thumb:** Any holiday that lands on a **Monday** or **Friday** will usually generate a 3‑day weekend. When two holidays sit back‑to‑back (Christmas + Boxing Day), you’ll get a 4‑day block.

---

### 3️⃣ Putting This Into Your App

```jsonc
{
  "year": 2023,
  "country": "CA",
  "longWeekends": [
    { "start":"2023-04-07", "end":"2023-04-09", "description":"Good Friday" },
    { "start":"2023-02-18", "end":"2023-02-20", "description":"Family Day (AB, BC, SK, NL)" },
    { "start":"2023-02-11", "end":"2023-02-13", "description":"Family Day (ON)" },
    { "start":"2023-05-21", "end":"2023-05-23", "description":"Victoria Day" },
    { "start":"2023-03-04", "end":"2023-03-06", "description":"St. Patrick’s Day (MB)" },
    { "start":"2023-08-05", "end":"2023-08-07", "description":"Civic/Holiday (PEI, NS, NT, NU, YT)" },
    { "start":"2023-09-02", "end":"2023-09-04", "description":"Labour Day" },
    { "start":"2023-06-22", "end":"2023-06-24", "description":"Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day (QC)" },
    { "start":"2023-12-23", "end":"2023-12-26", "description":"Christmas + Boxing Day" }
  ]
}
```

Feel free to filter by `province` field if you’re targeting users in specific regions.

--- 

#### Quick Checklist Before Deployment

1. **Verify Provincial Dates** – Some provinces change the exact day (e.g., Family Day moved to the first Monday in 2023 for Ontario).
2. **Add Substitute Days** – Certain provinces offer a “substitute holiday” if a statutory holiday falls on a weekend (e.g., Ontario’s “Statutory Holiday” on the following Monday). Decide whether to expose those.
3. **Local Observances** – Cities often declare local holidays (e.g., Toronto’s “Toronto City Hall Holiday”). You can optionally surface those as optional filters.

Happy coding—and enjoy those well‑deserved long weekends!
